H01.description: Crate version bump only; no behaviour change.

H02.description: Adds chrono dependency needed by the new modified-date based packument format selection.

H03.description: Head always fetches the full packument when minimumDependencyAge is set, even for packages whose abbreviated manifest's modified date shows the full packument isn't needed, and does not tie Full to the no-downgrade trust policy (intent partly unclear from the context; reads as a correctness/efficiency fix to format selection).

H04.description: Adds a doc comment to the trait method.

H05.description: Passes the requested packument format to the HTTP client as part of the format-selection fix.

H06.description: Removes the unused packument format parameter as part of the format-selection fix.

H07.description: Carries the cached modified date through for the format-selection fix.

H08.description: Signature updated to the new request-format type.

H09.description: Comparison updated to the new request-format type.

H10.description: Parameter rename so the full-packument flag can also be derived from the response.

H11.description: When a registry ignores the Accept header and returns a full packument for an abbreviated request, head does not record the full-packument marker, so the cache entry is misclassified as abbreviated.

H12.description: Keeps the manifest's modified date in the slim cache, needed for the format-selection fix.

H13.description: A malformed non-object `scripts` field in any version makes slimming fail with an error, so the entire packument fails to load.

H15.description: Adds tests for format selection, modified retention and malformed scripts.
